title: Same-bound cooperative two-member A-policy delivery (draft)
description: After successful bridge.bind.cooperative.v3 HMAC proof on one B-client/H-server broker connection, B calls bridge.member-policy.v3 on that same connection with only its exact A-signed primary reservation and detached cooperative B assignment envelope hashes. H returns full exact A-signed #85 member-set assignment and #87 two-member B authority JCS envelopes as unpadded base64url with SHA-256 of each envelope's raw bytes. H cannot mint policy rows. B verifies both purposes, signatures, exact JCS, fixed installed A pin, assignment and authority cross-hash, primary reservation and detached B assignment digests, two selectors/launch/command/adjacent CLI bytes and endpoint parent identities before any member observe/arm or R/provider traffic. Missing, swapped or changed envelope refuses; no new listener or pre-bind delivery.
